hints.title: Cross Join Partitioning
hints.text: Every valid chemical bond pairs a Metal element with a Nonmetal element.

hints.title: Column Aliasing
hints.text: Filter the first instance of Elements for Metal type and the second instance for Nonmetal type.

hints.title: Output Projections
hints.text: Select the symbol of the metal as column metal and the symbol of the nonmetal as column nonmetal.

hints.title: Bond Formation Cross Join Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    m.symbol AS metal, 
    n.symbol AS nonmetal
FROM Elements AS m
JOIN Elements AS n 
  ON m.type = 'Metal' AND n.type = 'Nonmetal';
```

complexity.notes: Direct Cartesian cross-product between filtered partitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries examining each element independently add superfluous overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) memory for the output result rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Performs filtered table join between disjoint category partitions.
